Article 1

Subject matter

1. The aim of this Regulation is to contribute to the proper functioning of the internal market.

2. This Regulation lays down harmonised rules. In particular, it establishes:

(a)

a framework for the conditional exemption from liability;

(b)

rules on due diligence obligations for providers;

Article 2

Scope

For the purpose of this Regulation, the following introductory note shall apply:

(a)

an introductory definition;

1. This Regulation shall apply to intermediary services offered in the Union.

Article 8

No general monitoring obligations

No general obligation to monitor the information which providers transmit shall be imposed.
